criterion.criterion_summary: Keep explicitly requested value data modalities hard across runtime hints, candidate-derived panel signals, and owner-projected manifest targets. Catalog changes must not weaken the request. A compatible method may be selected; incompatible selection must refuse with the precise modality blocker. A transformation claim requires a real producer, inputs, and verifiable output.
